items.t: CVT whine, shudder or slipping
items.note: Basis: KBB dealer price for a 2009 Rogue ($6,108–$6,566 total; parts $4,587–$4,919, labor $1,521–$1,647), as no parts-plus-labor source was found. A used or rebuilt CVT from an independent shop usually costs less. Nissan extended CVT coverage on some years, so ask a dealer first.

items.t: CVT judder, hesitation and failure
items.note: Basis: KBB dealer price for a 2014 Rogue ($6,484–$6,972 total; parts $4,869–$5,223, labor $1,615–$1,749), as no parts-plus-labor source was found. CarComplaints owners report a typical $2,800 for a 2018. Some mild cases are fixed by a software update and fluid change; ask a dealer about extended CVT coverage.
